thread:
Oncall Bot: Handoff reminder — new shift starting now. Primary: Sam R; Secondary: Maya L. Please confirm your access to PagerDuty, AWS, Grafana. (Shift 03/14)
Sam R: I’m primary, here. I'll take PD and Grafana, Maya you ok to be secondary for AWS?
Maya L: I can be secondary but I don't have the cross-account role in AWS prod yet. I only have staging.
Alex P: FYI I'm on-call backfill till 10:30p. I don't need prod AWS but need PagerDuty responder rights.
Sam R: @Maya L ok. @Alex P we need you in the oncall-pagerduty group. Ops to add -> send ticket.
Jordan T: ops here — tag me when you open the IAM ticket, include the exact role ARNs. Template in /handbooks/oncall-access.
Sam R: Incident note: Seeing a couple of 5xx spikes, incident-bot posted alert earlier, but seems transient. Keeping eyes on it.
Oncall Bot: ALERT: infra-api latency p99 > 2.5s for 5m — incident created (INC-2026). Escalation policy: infra-high-latency.
Maya L: I tried to open the AWS console with the prod role, I get AccessDenied on sts:AssumeRole. Screenshot uploaded in thread.
Sam R: Runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/infra/latency - Section 2 has immediate mitigation steps and the runbook for verifying caches.
Alex P: PD permissions needed: 'Responder' on service infra-api and ability to acknowledge incidents. @ops what's the quickest way to add?
Jordan T: Easiest is add to group 'oncall-responders' in Okta, which provisions PD role. I'll raise the Okta group change now. Mention this thread in ticket.
Sam R: Grafana: I need Editor on dashboard 'infra/latency' and Viewer on 'billing/*'. If someone lacks it, we can use temporary share link but it's clumsy during an incident.
Maya L: Can ops also add me to 'aws-prod-assume-oncall' role and 'oncall-responders' in Okta? I'll recheck after.
Jordan T: Ticket created: IAM-4572. Ops ETA ~20m for Okta PD group add, ~40-60m for AWS role if manual approval needed. If urgent, we can do temporary SAML session.
Sam R: Thanks. For clarity — actions: Jordan create Okta change (PD); Jordan create AWS ticket (role); Alex confirm PD access; Maya confirm AWS after provision. I'll keep monitoring INC-2026.
Alex P: Confirmed PD responder access received. I can ack/inc false positives. :thumbsup: 
Maya L: Got a console toast, assuming role works now. Able to list EC2 and view CloudWatch. I'll run the runbook checks.
Sam R: Great. If anything blocks, mention @ops and escalate to oncall pager duty admin (ops-admin). Good handoff everyone. :raised_hands:
